lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids to form a rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with specular highlights on the superior margin and shadows on the inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) clustered along the ventral-lateral boundary and the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
